title: [Shopify] Disambiguate Shopify timestamp field captions and tooltips
summary: Shopify timestamp field captions and tooltips are now clearly marked with a (Shopify) suffix and updated references to improve disambiguation from Business Central's system auditing fields.
key_points: Added (Shopify) suffix to 20 timestamp field captions across 11 tables in the Shopify connector
Updated page tooltips to mention 'in Shopify' as the data source
Fixed caption bug on Shpfy Variant CreatedAt field and typo in refund tooltips
Corrected misleading wording on Order Transaction Created At tooltip
No schema, logic, API changes or breaking changes; display-only modifications
